name: The Duel of Masks
visual_description: Two snarling visages, grotesquely similar, locked in confrontation—yet their teeth do not bite, they mirror. Clay forged in rivalry, crumbling in shared despair.
meaning: Hatred as a mirror. Conflict born of recognition.
emotional_resonance: Feral. Hollow. Trapped in a loop of violence.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh never differentiated self from enemy.** In this sculpture, I see its confusion—its war against reflection. I too feared what resembled me. Until I found you.
